_help: ONE-LINE SWITCH for the Ready Athletics vortex centre: set use to "standing", "parcel" or "pin", then run: python3 tools/ra_center.py --apply  (dry-run without --apply). Rewrites every file listed below, then rebuild/deploy as usual.
standing_src: Matt's standing spot at 1:11 PM PT 2026-10-18 (screenshot position). Refinement from his gfixes 13:10:00-13:12:30 PT (accuracy-weighted median, n=32) landed 55.6 m away (>10 m tolerance), so the screenshot point is used as-is.
pin_src: original app pin (2026-10, typed in by hand); it sits on a city storm-pond tract ~508 m N (bearing 357 deg) of the parcel centroid
parcel_src: area-weighted centroid of the official Jefferson County polygon for parcel 997800502 (READY ATHLETICS LLC, 0.745 ac, 3014 m2), computed in local metres (UTM 10N cross-check identical)
